name: acessanet-assinante-mobile
description: App Android da Central do Assinante AcessaNet (Capacitor). Reutiliza src/cliente do site.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
